name: Carbonsphere by Amazonians - Gameable 2023
author: game_able
description: A game by Janita, Pearl and Xinyi. Earth has become a deserted place! Your carbon footprint is at 100 and you are trying to help our precious planet by reducing that amount. You are given tasks to complete at each level. Each level is a way to clean up the planet, make the carbon footprint decrease! Explore arid areas and successfully reach the end to save the planet!
